title: Signal tools
prompt: Implement `MovingAverage` and `IsPalindrome` as described. Watch the window contract (≥1 or throw; result length is Length - window + 1) and the palindrome null/empty distinction.

tests.name: moving-average
tests.hint: Length contract, exact window means, the too-big-window rule, and the guard.

tests.name: palindrome
tests.hint: The null/empty asymmetry is the trap: empty is trivially a palindrome, null is no data at all.
